title: The long path
goals: Reach the foot of the steps.
Do it in fewer than 2 lines.
starting_code:
# Go to the foot of the steps in one instruction.
# Tell the action how many steps to take.
hints: Put the number inside the brackets.
You need to take six steps to the left.
Use the `move_left` action and tell it to take 6 steps.
intro: This path is long. Writing the same instruction many times is slow. You can tell an action how much to do!
outro: That was much faster! You reached the steps in no time.
learned: Now you know about how much, which programmers call an argument.
